title: wblrnd

gpu_support.notes: Sampling uses the host RNG path. Floating resident parameters gather automatically and the result returns to the selected owning provider with its documented precision.

description: `wblrnd(a,b)` generates Weibull random samples with scale parameter `a` and shape parameter `b`. Size-vector and dimension-list forms are supported.
behaviors: `a` and `b` support scalar expansion and matching array shapes.

The documented parameter and size classes are single and double. Typed-integer parameter and size forms are independently gated RunMat extensions; integer parameters must be exactly representable at the sampling boundary, while integer sizes are parsed structurally.
Without explicit size arguments, the output shape is the scalar-expanded parameter shape.
With explicit size arguments, nonscalar parameters must match the requested shape.
Output is single when either documented parameter is single and double otherwise.

faqs.question: How are samples generated?
faqs.answer: RunMat uses inverse-transform sampling with `a * (-log(U))^(1/b)` and the shared RunMat RNG.
